sources.researchNote: The label image accompanying the upload reads “Best.-Nr. 3098” and names Bernard Etté und sein Orchester and refrain singer Kurt Mühlhardt. It corrects the upload description’s “Kristall 78N”; the earlier claim that no label was shown was incorrect. SRC0004 shows the other title on the same catalogue issue, also numbered 3098; this does not establish that the transfers came from the same physical copy. The description’s “Aufnahme 1930” remains a reported recording year, not a separately established issue date.
